sections.title: Echoes
sections.note: All 127 Echoes in Notebook order (No. 1-127). Region and area give an early, reliable place to learn each one; many appear in several places. None are missable.

items.name: Table
items.howTo: The first Echo: learn the table in Zelda's prison cell right after Tri gives her the Tri Rod.

items.name: Old Bed
items.howTo: Learned during the prologue escape, in the room where you meet Impa (same room as the Decorative Shrub).

items.name: Soft Bed
items.howTo: Learn the bed inside the house at the Oasis (the Tough Mango Plant Lab).
items.notes: No. 3. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Nintendo Life also lists Gerudo Town.

items.name: Zelda's Bed
items.howTo: Learn Zelda's own bed in Zelda's Room in the right wing of Hyrule Castle.

items.name: Decorative Shrub
items.howTo: Learned in the room where you meet Impa during the prologue escape.

items.name: Wooden Box
items.howTo: Learn one of the wooden boxes just after leaving the prison cell.

items.name: Pot
items.howTo: Learn a pot inside the houses of Suthorn Village (first house on the right).
items.notes: No. 7. Cost: 1 triangle (base). Zelda Wiki also lists pots in the Hyrule Castle Barracks.

items.name: Hyrule Castle Pot
items.howTo: Learn the ornate pot on a shelf while sneaking through the castle in the prologue.

items.name: Gerudo Pot
items.howTo: Learn a Gerudo-style pot in the caves of Gerudo Desert (e.g. the Ancestor's Cave of Rest) or in Gerudo Town.

items.name: Boulder
items.howTo: Learn the boulder blocking the path in the Royal-Family Shortcut while escaping the castle.

items.name: Rock
items.howTo: Learn a rock on Suthorn Beach right after washing up there.

items.name: Lava Rock
items.howTo: Learn a rock floating on the lava in Eldin Volcano (the lava area where Torch Slugs appear).

items.name: Ice Block
items.howTo: Learn the ice block inside the cave whose snowed-in entrance Condé clears on the way up Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Snowball
items.howTo: Learn one of the snowballs rolling down the slope near the summit while following Condé.

items.name: Sign
items.howTo: Learn the wooden sign at the east exit of Suthorn Village near the waypoint.

items.name: Grilled Fish
items.howTo: Start the side quest "Deliver the Grilled Fish!" in Seesyde Village; the grilled fish can then be learned.
items.notes: No. 16. Cost: 1 triangle (base). Zelda Wiki also lists it in Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den.

items.name: Meat
items.howTo: Learn the meat roasting in the fireplace of a house in Suthorn Village.

items.name: Rock Roast
items.howTo: Learn the rock roast inside the Rock-Roast Quarry during The Rift on Eldin Volcano.

items.name: Stuffed Toy
items.howTo: Light the two braziers beside the wide tombstone in the Graveyard (north Hyrule Field, next to the Northern Sanctuary); it slides back to reveal stairs to a cave holding the Stuffed Toy.

items.name: Carrot
items.howTo: During the side quest "Impa's Gift", mend the Stilled Carrot Patch rift; carrots can then be learned at the Carrot Patch.

items.name: Water Block
items.howTo: Learn a water block inside the Stilled Jabul Waters rift on the way to the Jabul Ruins.

items.name: Elephant Statue
items.howTo: Learn the elephant statue inside the Gerudo Sanctum (2F, after the Link miniboss).
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Hawk Statue
items.howTo: Learn the hawk statue on top of a pillar in the Stilled Gerudo Sanctum, outside the Sanctum (Bind a layer to reveal the rest of its ladder).
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Cat Statue
items.howTo: Learn the cat statue inside the Gerudo Sanctum.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Snake Statue
items.howTo: Learn the snake statues inside the Gerudo Sanctum (2F, past the main door of the first area).
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Ancient Orb
items.howTo: Learn an orb beside the stone pedestals in the Eternal Forest; the orbs only appear during The Prime Energy and Null.
items.notes: No. 26. Cost: 1 triangle (base). Required for the main quest, so it cannot be missed.

items.name: Trampoline
items.howTo: Learn the trampoline next to the shop in Suthorn Village.

items.name: Wind Cannon
items.area: Southern Gerudo Desert ruins (cave east of the waypoint)
items.howTo: Learn a wind cannon in the cave in the southern desert ruins (east of the waypoint) or in the Cryptic Cavern.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert
items.notes: No. 28. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Zelda Dungeon names the southern ruins cave as where it is first learned; Game8 names the Cryptic Cavern.

items.name: Flying Tile
items.howTo: Learn a flying tile in the Gerudo Sanctum (2F, to the left).
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert
items.notes: No. 29. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Also in a cave on the cliffs above the northwestern desert Monster Outpost and in the Stilled Northern Gerudo Desert cave (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Cloud
items.howTo: Learn one of the petrified clouds inside the Stilled Hebra Mountain rift at the summit.

items.name: Spiked Roller
items.howTo: Learn a spiked roller in the side-scrolling cave east of Kakariko Village (the cave that also holds a Piece of Heart).

items.name: Beetle Mound
items.area: Cave east of the northern desert waypoint
items.howTo: Learn a beetle mound in the cave north of the Oasis (east of the northern waypoint, northeast of Gerudo Town).
items.notes: No. 32. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Also in the Gerudo Sanctum and the central cave of Eldin Volcano Trail.

items.name: Firework
items.howTo: Complete the side quest "The Fireworks Artist" (from Basa in Goron City), then learn the firework.

items.name: Brazier
items.howTo: Learn one of the braziers at the entrance of the cave south of the Suthorn Ruins (the Peahat cave).

items.name: Zol
items.howTo: Defeat a Zol on Suthorn Beach after leaving the shore and learn its Shimmer.

items.name: Ignizol
items.howTo: Defeat the Ignizol in the cave near the Suthorn Forest entrance, east of Suthorn Village.
items.notes: No. 36. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Nintendo Life lists the Suthorn Ruins.

items.name: Hydrozol
items.area: Cave Along the Beach (west Zora Cove)
items.howTo: Defeat a Hydrozol in the Cave Along the Beach at the western end of Zora Cove (north of the Wrecked Ship).
items.notes: No. 37. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Game8 and Nintendo Life list the Faron Wetlands entrance, which comes later in the story.

items.name: Buzz Blob
items.howTo: Defeat a Buzz Blob in the swampy areas of the Faron Wetlands.

items.name: Spear Moblin
items.howTo: Defeat a Spear Moblin at the Monster Outpost east of Lueburry's House in Suthorn Forest.

items.name: Spear Moblin Lv. 2
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field Monster Outpost (west of the Eastern Temple)
items.howTo: Defeat one at the Monster Outpost west of the Eastern Temple.
items.notes: No. 40. Cost: 4 triangles (base). Also at the Zora River outpost southwest of River Zora Village, on Hebra Mountain, and in the southwest Eternal Forest (Game8).

items.name: Sword Moblin
items.area: Suthorn Forest Monster Outpost (southeast of Suthorn Ruins)
items.howTo: Defeat one at the Monster Outpost southeast of the Suthorn Ruins.
items.notes: No. 41. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Common at Hyrule Field Monster Outposts; Game8 lists the camp on the eastern edge of Hyrule Field.

items.name: Sword Moblin Lv. 2
items.area: Eastern Hyrule Field Monster Outpost (northeast of Lake Hylia)
items.howTo: Defeat one at the Monster Outpost northeast of Lake Hylia.
items.notes: No. 42. Cost: 4 triangles (base). Also near the east entrance of the Eternal Forest (Game8) and on Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Sword Moblin Lv. 3
items.howTo: From the central Eternal Forest waypoint head west; a lone Sword Moblin Lv. 3 guards a buried chest.
items.notes: No. 43. Cost: 5 triangles (base). Zelda Wiki also lists a cave north of a Hebra Mountain Monster Outpost.

items.name: Club Boarblin
items.area: Desert Monster Outposts (north of the Oasis)
items.howTo: Defeat one at the Boarblin Monster Outposts north of the Oasis and Gerudo Town.

items.name: Club Boarblin Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat one at the northwestern Monster Outpost north of Gerudo Town (west of the Ancestor's Cave of Rest).

items.name: Boomerang Boarblin
items.area: Desert Monster Outposts (north of the Oasis)
items.howTo: Found alongside Club Boarblins at the Monster Outposts north of the Oasis and Gerudo Town.

items.name: Boomerang Boarblin Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat one at the northwestern Monster Outpost north of Gerudo Town (west of the Ancestor's Cave of Rest).

items.name: Lynel
items.howTo: Follow the trail of hoof prints through the Eternal Forest exactly; straying resets it. At the end the Lynel appears; defeat it and learn its Shimmer.
items.notes: No. 48. Cost: 6 triangles (base). Easy to overlook. Also fought in Null's Body.

items.name: Lizalfos
items.howTo: Defeat a Lizalfos on Eldin Volcano Trail or around Eldin Volcano.

items.name: Lizalfos Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat one in the deeper part of the Lizalfos Burrow.

items.name: Lizalfos Lv. 3
items.howTo: Defeat one in the cave north of the Heart Lake waypoint (the cave with the Armos).

items.name: Darknut
items.howTo: Defeat the Darknut on 2F of the Suthorn Ruins.

items.name: Darknut Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat the Darknut Lv. 2 in an early room of the Still World Hyrule Castle dungeon.

items.name: Darknut Lv. 3
items.howTo: Defeat one deep inside the East Ruins, east of Scrubton.

items.name: Armos
items.howTo: Defeat an Armos deep in the cave north of the Heart Lake waypoint.
items.notes: No. 55. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Also in the East Ruins and the Faron Temple.

items.name: Ball-and-Chain Trooper
items.howTo: Defeat the Ball-and-Chain Trooper in the basement of the Still World Hyrule Castle dungeon.

items.name: Gibdo
items.howTo: Defeat a Gibdo in the Cryptic Cavern (to the right of the first area).
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert
items.notes: No. 57. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Also in the Gerudo Sanctum.

items.name: Gibdo Lv. 2
items.howTo: Climb down the ladder to the lower level of the Cryptic Cavern and defeat the Gibdo Lv. 2.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: ReDead
items.howTo: Defeat a ReDead roaming the desert south of the Oasis.

items.name: Fire Wizzrobe
items.howTo: Defeat the Fire Wizzrobe miniboss on 1F of the Eldin Temple.
items.notes: No. 60. Cost: 5 triangles (base). Zelda Wiki also lists Eldin Volcano and the Stilled Western Eldin Volcano rift.

items.name: Ice Wizzrobe
items.howTo: Defeat the Ice Wizzrobe around the icy lake to the right of the path towards Holy Mount Lanayru.

items.name: Electric Wizzrobe
items.area: Shallow ponds east of the Heart Lake cave
items.howTo: After exiting the cave at Heart Lake, head right; an Electric Wizzrobe floats over the nearby pond.

items.name: Caromadillo
items.area: Suthorn Forest cave (south of the Monster Outpost)
items.howTo: Defeat the Caromadillo in the small cave south of the Suthorn Forest Monster Outpost (the Piece of Heart cave).

items.name: Caromadillo Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat one on 1F of the Gerudo Sanctum.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert
items.notes: No. 64. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Zelda Wiki also lists Eastern Hyrule Field and the Eastern Temple, which may come earlier.

items.name: Rope
items.howTo: Ropes hide in the grass of Suthorn Forest.

items.name: Tornando
items.howTo: Defeat a Tornando in the open Gerudo Desert.

items.name: Ribbitune
items.howTo: Ribbitunes gather in groups in eastern Hyrule Field.
items.notes: No. 67. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Exact spot differs by source: Nintendo Life says near Dampé Studio, Game8 says northeast of a cemetery waypoint.

items.name: Drippitune
items.howTo: Defeat a Drippitune near the entrance of the Faron Wetlands.

items.name: Torch Slug
items.area: Eldin Volcano Trail / lava near Goron City
items.howTo: Defeat a Torch Slug in the lava areas of Eldin Volcano Trail and near Goron City.
items.notes: No. 69. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Zelda Wiki also lists the Stilled Southern Hyrule Field rift (side quest From the Heart).

items.name: Freeze Slug
items.area: Stilled Hebra Mountain cave / Lanayru Temple
items.howTo: Defeat one in the cave inside the Stilled Hebra Mountain rift, or on the walls of the Lanayru Temple.

items.name: Holmill
items.howTo: In the Ancestor's Cave of Rest, use Bind to move the boulder on the left side and go through the door to the Holmill room.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Wolfos
items.area: Hyrule Field woods (around Hyrule Castle Town)
items.howTo: Defeat a Wolfos in the wooded parts of Hyrule Field around Hyrule Castle Town (a sign in the southern woods warns of them).
items.notes: No. 72. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Game8 and Nintendo Life place it in Hyrule Field; Zelda Wiki's location lists only Hebra Mountain and late-game Still World areas.

items.name: White Wolfos
items.howTo: Defeat the White Wolfos in the Lanayru Temple (B4, room after the two-switch room).

items.name: Keese
items.howTo: Defeat the first Keese inside the Beach Cave on Suthorn Beach.

items.name: Fire Keese
items.howTo: Defeat a Fire Keese inside the Lizalfos Burrow.
items.notes: No. 75. Cost: 4 triangles (base). Also in the Eldin Temple and the Summit Cave.

items.name: Ice Keese
items.howTo: Defeat an Ice Keese on Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Electric Keese
items.howTo: Defeat one inside the Stilled Faron Wetlands rift.
items.after: A Rift in the Faron Wetlands
items.notes: No. 77. Cost: 4 triangles (base). Also in the Faron Temple.

items.name: Mothula
items.howTo: Defeat a Mothula in the Gerudo Sanctum (2F, past the Snake Statues) or the Stilled Gerudo Sanctum.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Mothula Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat one southwest of Scrubton or in the Stilled Faron Wetlands left of the Faron Temple.

items.name: Needlefly
items.howTo: Needleflies fly over the waters of the Zora River.
items.notes: No. 80. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Base cost 2 per Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon; Game8 lists 5.

items.name: Albatrawl
items.howTo: From the waypoint near Crossflows Plaza go south and swim along the coast; Albatrawls fly over Zora Cove.

items.name: Crow
items.howTo: Crows perch near Hyrule Ranch; they also appear at the canyon entrance to the Gerudo Desert.
items.notes: No. 82. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Game8 says the Suthorn area; Zelda Wiki and Nintendo Life say Hyrule Field and Gerudo Desert.

items.name: Beakon
items.howTo: Defeat a Beakon in the southeast of the Faron Wetlands.

items.name: Guay
items.howTo: From Hyrule Ranch head east; Guays fly around the trees.

items.name: Octorok
items.howTo: Defeat an Octorok in the ponds of Suthorn Prairie, north of Suthorn Village.

items.name: Fire Octo
items.howTo: Fire Octos swim in the lava of Eldin Volcano.

items.name: Ice Octo
items.howTo: Ice Octos swim in the icy water of Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Sea Urchin
items.howTo: Learn a Sea Urchin blocking the path to the Beach Cave on Suthorn Beach.

items.name: Sand Crab
items.area: Beach at the west entrance of Jabul Waters
items.howTo: Sand Crabs roam the sandy beach where you enter Jabul Waters from Eastern Hyrule Field.

items.name: Biri
items.area: Stilled Upper Zora River (Still World) / Zora Cove
items.howTo: Defeat a Biri in the cave of the Stilled Upper Zora River rift (Chaos at River Zora Village) or in Zora Cove.

items.name: Tangler
items.howTo: Tanglers swim in Lake Hylia (also in Zora Cove).

items.name: Tangler Lv. 2
items.area: Jabul Ruins / Zora Cove underwater cave
items.howTo: Defeat one in the Jabul Ruins or in the underwater cave along the eastern edge of Zora Cove.

items.name: Bombfish
items.area: Stilled Upper Zora River (Still World) / Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den
items.howTo: Defeat a Bombfish in the Stilled Upper Zora River rift during Chaos at River Zora Village, or in the water at Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den.

items.name: Chompfin
items.howTo: Chompfins swim in Zora Cove and in the Jabul Ruins.

items.name: Piranha
items.howTo: Piranhas swim in the swamps of the Faron Wetlands.

items.name: Sand Piranha
items.howTo: Sand Piranhas swim through the sand of the Gerudo Desert.

items.name: Deku Baba
items.howTo: Defeat a Deku Baba on 1F of the Suthorn Ruins (room below the waypoint).

items.name: Bio Deku Baba
items.howTo: Defeat one in the Jabul Ruins (left of the water-mechanism area, down the ladder).

items.name: Deku Baba Lv. 2
items.area: Stilled Heart Lake (Still World) / Faron Wetlands
items.howTo: Defeat one in the Stilled Heart Lake rift or on the path southeast of the Scrubton smoothie shop.

items.name: Peahat
items.area: Suthorn Forest (cave south of Suthorn Ruins)
items.howTo: Defeat the lone Peahat in the cave south of the Suthorn Ruins (braziers at its entrance).

items.name: Giant Goponga Flower
items.howTo: Defeat a Giant Goponga Flower growing in the swamp water.

items.name: Zirro
items.howTo: Defeat the first Zirro inside the Stilled Goron City rift.
items.notes: No. 102. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Nintendo Life lists Hebra Mountain caves.

items.name: Ghirro
items.howTo: Defeat a Ghirro in the cave west of Eldin Volcano Trail (Stilled Western Eldin Volcano area) or in the Eldin Temple.

items.name: Mini-Moldorm
items.area: Northwest Hyrule Field near Kakariko Village
items.howTo: Mini-Moldorms crawl around northwest Hyrule Field near Kakariko and at the start of Eldin Volcano Trail.
items.notes: No. 104. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon also place three in a raised part of Suthorn Forest reached from Lake Hylia.

items.name: Strandtula
items.howTo: Defeat the Strandtula hanging from a thread on 1F of the Suthorn Ruins.

items.name: Crawltula
items.howTo: Crawltulas crawl around Suthorn Prairie.

items.name: Baby Gohma
items.howTo: Common in the Faron Wetlands near spider webs and caves.

items.name: Beetle
items.area: Cave east of the northern desert waypoint
items.howTo: Defeat a Beetle spawned by the Beetle Mounds in the cave north of the Oasis.

items.name: Aruroda
items.howTo: Arurodas burrow in the open Gerudo Desert and its caves.

items.name: Tektite
items.howTo: Tektites hop on the water at Lake Hylia.
items.notes: No. 110. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Sources differ: Game8 says the water at Seesyde Village, Nintendo Life says near Hyrule Ranch; Zelda Wiki lists Lake Hylia and Zora River.

items.name: Tektite Lv. 2
items.howTo: Defeat one in the Lanayru Temple (B4, the room where you thaw the ice).
items.notes: No. 111. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Zelda Wiki also lists a cave on Hebra Mountain between the Smoothie Shop and the waterfall.

items.name: Hoarder
items.howTo: Hoarders disguise themselves as mushrooms in the Wetlands; examine one to make it appear.

items.name: Poe
items.howTo: Defeat a Poe on 1F of the Gerudo Sanctum (path to the left when you return to 1F).
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert
items.notes: No. 113. Cost: 4 triangles (base). Also on the Wrecked Ship.

items.name: Moa
items.howTo: A floating eye found on the way up Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Goo Specter
items.area: East side of the Faron Wetlands
items.howTo: Defeat one in the eastern Faron Wetlands or inside the Stilled Faron Wetlands rift.

items.name: Ghini
items.howTo: Defeat a Ghini inside the Stilled Northern Sanctuary rift.
items.notes: No. 116. Cost: 1 triangle (base). Also in the Graveyard.

items.name: Ghini Lv. 2
items.howTo: Go deeper into the cave under the Graveyard's wide tombstone (past the Stuffed Toy) and defeat the Ghini Lv. 2.

items.name: Leever
items.howTo: Leevers burrow along the paths of Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Pathblade
items.howTo: Pathblades block the main path through the Cryptic Cavern.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Gustmaster
items.howTo: Defeat one in the Hyrule Castle dungeon (B2, behind the door opened by lighting three braziers).

items.name: Tweelus
items.howTo: Tweelus gather northeast of Goron City and in the Rock-Roast Quarry.

items.name: Temper Tweelus
items.howTo: Defeat one in the cave with the hot spring at the summit of Hebra Mountain.
items.notes: No. 122. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Also in the Lanayru Temple.

items.name: Freezard
items.howTo: Freezards sit on icy ground on Hebra Mountain (also in the Lanayru Temple).

items.name: Snomaul
items.howTo: Defeat a Snomaul just after entering Hebra Mountain.

items.name: Spark
items.howTo: Defeat a Spark just inside the entrance of the Eastern Temple (optional dungeon; side quest "Let's Play a Game").
items.notes: No. 125. Cost: 2 triangles (base). Also in the Hidden Ruins (Faron Wetlands).

items.name: Platboom
items.howTo: Defeat a Platboom in the Stilled Desert Temple Ruins rift, or in the cave on the cliffs behind the Gerudo Palace.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert
items.notes: No. 126. Cost: 3 triangles (base). Also in a cave in the Stilled Carrot Patch rift.

items.name: Beamos
items.howTo: Defeat a Beamos in the East Ruins east of Scrubton, or in the Faron Temple.
